import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Define paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_FILE_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Identify feature columns (exclude id, target)
feature_columns = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]
print(f"Feature columns loaded: {len(feature_columns)}")

# Preprocess features - Handle categorical encoding for object columns
X_train = train_df[feature_columns].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_columns].copy()

# Encode categorical columns properly
categorical_cols = X_train.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns
print(f"Categorical columns found: {list(categorical_cols)}")

for col in categorical_cols:
    # Get unique values from training data
    unique_vals = X_train[col].drop_duplicates()
    val_counts = unique_vals.value_counts()

    # Take top N most frequent values to limit encoding space
    max_unique = min(len(val_counts), 5000)
    top_vals = val_counts.head(max_unique).index.tolist()

    # Create label mapping
    le = LabelEncoder()
    le.fit(top_vals)

    X_train[col] = X_train[col].map(
        lambda x: (
            le.transform([x])[0]
            if x in le.classes_
            else le.transform(["__missing__"])[0]
        )
    )
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].map(
        lambda x: (
            le.transform([x])[0]
            if x in le.classes_
            else le.transform(["__missing__"])[0]
        )
    )

    # Fill any remaining unmapped values
    X_train[col] = X_train[col].fillna(-999)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].fillna(-999)

# Convert all columns to numeric
X_train = X_train.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
X_test = X_test.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

# Fill NaNs with median
X_train = X_train.fillna(X_train.median())
X_test = X_test.fillna(X_test.median())

print(f"X_train shape: {X_train.shape}")
print(f"X_test shape: {X_test.shape}")

y_train = train_df["target"].values

# Split train into train/val (Genuine holdout - do NOT refit on this)
X_train_final, X_val, y_train_t, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train, shuffle=False
)

print(f"Final Train size: {X_train_final.shape[0]}, Val size: {X_val.shape[0]}")

# Train Model on TRAIN DATA ONLY (never touch val/test data during training)
clf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=500, random_state=42, max_depth=20, min_samples_leaf=10, n_jobs=-1
)
clf.fit(X_train_final.values, y_train_t)

# Prediction on Test Set (Genuine heldout - model never seen this)
test_y_prob = clf.predict_proba(X_test.values)[:, 1]
test_preds_flat = np.array(test_y_prob)

# Validation Metric (HOLD OUT - genuine holdout estimate)
if X_val.shape[0] > 0:
    y_val_pred_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val.values)[:, 1]
    valid_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred_proba)
    print(f"\nValidation AUC-ROC Score on Genuine Hold-Out Set: {valid_auc:.5f}")
else:
    print("\nWarning: No validation data available")
    valid_auc = None

# Save Submission File (CRITICAL: MUST create ./submission/submission.csv)
sample_sub["target"] = test_preds_flat
sample_sub.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE_PATH, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission file created: {SUBMISSION_FILE_PATH}")
print(f"Number of rows in submission: {len(sample_sub)}")

# Final Output - Competition-specific requirement
if valid_auc is not None:
    print(f"Genuine Hold-Out Validation AUC-ROC Score: {valid_auc:.5f}")
else:
    print("No validation available for metric reporting")
